paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas and card surfaces — warm off-white reads as aged paper, not digital white

bone.$description: Bone — Elevated surface and subtle washes — used for card backgrounds and hover states, one step warmer than canvas

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, navigation, borders, and outlined actions — near-black with a warm undertone, never pure #000

ash.$description: Ash — Muted text and secondary borders — warm gray for metadata, subtitles, and hairline dividers

pebble.$description: Pebble — Light dividers and structural borders — barely visible rules between sections

mist.$description: Mist — Form input borders — slightly warmer than pebble to read as a distinct UI surface

nomen-nescio-custom.$description: Single-weight display and body sans-serif — a monoline custom face used for every text element on the site. No bold, no light, no italic variants exist; hierarchy is achieved through size and negative letter-spacing only. Substitutes with a similar monoline character: 'Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro' or 'Söhne' at weight 400.
